**1) Close button visibility & styling:**
Yes — visible. It's a white circle with a thin gold/tan ring border and a dark "×" inside, positioned at the top-right of the modal (correct for RTL, where the "start" side is right).

**2) Overlap with text:**
Yes, there's an overlap problem. The red label "▲ عله قريب" sits immediately to the left of the X button, and the button's gold ring visually touches/crowds it — the label is too close to the button, appearing to nearly collide. In a proper RTL layout the title row should have enough padding so the close button doesn't encroach on the text.

**3) RTL modal layout:**
Mostly clean: title "بازده واقعی طلا (خالص از تورم)" and the two-line description are right-aligned, fully readable, and nothing is clipped. However, the red tag at the top is squeezed against the close button, breaking the spacing of the header row.

**4) Verdict:**
The close button is **functional and usable** — it's circular, contrasted, and in the correct RTL position — but the layout needs a fix: add spacing/padding between the button and the red label so it doesn't overlap/crowd the header text.
